title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the phase shift as pi + tan^{-1}(2/rho).

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the boundary conditions for electric and magnetic fields at the interface.

title: Field Relationships
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly relate the amplitudes of the incident, reflected, and transmitted electric fields.

title: Phase Shift Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the phase shift from the reflection coefficient accurately.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the reflection coefficient calculation.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student should mention the limiting case when rho equals 0 and its implications.
